title: Anduril in Talks at $100B Valuation, 3x Last Year’s Mark
excerpt: Anduril is reportedly negotiating a $100 billion funding round, tripling its valuation from 2025. The surge underscores surging investor demand for defense technology and autonomous systems. The company now stands among the most valuable private entities globally.
description: Anduril in talks for $100B funding round, tripling valuation from last year. The surge reflects booming investor interest in AI defense technology and autonomous systems.
